tools.name: get_grocery_catalog
tools.description: Discover GroceryPulse's configured Canadian cities, canonical reference items, quantity units, known chains and checkout eligibility holds. Configured coverage is not current availability or coverage of every nearby branch. Call before matching an explicit shopper list; ask before substituting varia

tools.name: compare_grocery_list
tools.description: Read current public chain comparisons for an explicit supported Canadian city and canonical list. A lowest-chain recommendation requires fresh full requested coverage at two eligible chains with no close call or package/reference-size reversal. Preserve missing items, exclusions, price dates, scope

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_grocery_list · Private data: compare_grocery_list · Public sink: compare_grocery_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_grocery_list · Private data: compare_grocery_list · Public sink: compare_grocery_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
